noun_definition: Fab menu refers to a user interface component that allows users to select options by clicking a plus button and navigating through choices using arrow keys.
Enter refers to the key on a keyboard that, when pressed after selecting an option in the FAB menu, is expected to open the corresponding page but sometimes fails to do so.
Option page refers to the specific interface or screen that is intended to be displayed when a user selects an option from the FAB menu and presses Enter.
